title: Attack on Saudi's Dammam airport leaves 1 dead, 8 injured

blocks.text: RIYADH, Saudi Arabia — One Saudi resident was killed in an attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam in eastern Saudi Arabia on the Persian Gulf near Bahrain and Qatar, the Saudi Civil Aviation Authority announced early Thursday. The aviation authority also said eight people were injured in the late Wednesday attack and the airport suffered some material damages. Global flight-tracking service Flightradar24 said on X that flights have been diverted away from the airport. Authorities did not say who carried out the attack or provide further details.
